sections.h2: How Do Kuwait Buyers Find Suppliers Online?
sections.intro: Search behaviour in Kuwait has a few clear patterns that shape our strategy:

items.html: Mobile and Maps: most local searches happen on phones, and many end with a call or a direction request, not a website visit.
English and Arabic: Kuwaiti customers often search in Arabic, while the large expatriate community searches mostly in English.
Word of mouth goes online: buyers check reviews and Instagram before they call, so your Google reviews, photos and website must look current and match each other.
Prices matter: pages that show prices in KWD, delivery areas and payment options such as KNET get more enquiries.

sections.h2: Tracking and Data Privacy in Kuwait

paragraphs.html: Kuwait does not yet have one general data protection law. The main rules are the Electronic Transactions Law and the Data Privacy Protection Regulation issued by CITRA, which applies mainly to licensed telecom and internet providers. Even so, we follow good practice for every Kuwait website: a clear consent banner, a plain privacy notice and lead forms that ask only for what you need. See CITRA's website for official guidance, and ask your legal adviser to review your privacy notice.
